summary: W17 is the first v4.4 three-run week (Adj #244): Mon LONG 70 min / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 6×1K / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 5×1000m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. Target ~20 mpw, the peak under the new template. Monday carries the whole week — it is W17's entire easy fraction, so a yellow §11.C read trims it in minutes and never moves it; Sun is off by rule and there is no punt slot. MONDAY DELIVERED: 70:42 / 7.39 mi @ 9:34/mi, RPE "very easy" — the first long in its programmed slot since W13 after three straight weeks lost (Adj #254). HILL STRIDES REMOVED from the program the same day — program.md now v4.5, no stride slot in any future brief, and §6 carries no lower-body neuromuscular work at all (Adj #255). One watch off the long: miles 7-8 ran 8:36/9:04 below the easy band by choice, at roughly threshold cardiac cost — noise once, a conversation if it repeats at the W18 Mon long (Adj #256). TUESDAY DELIVERED, and it was the best lift day of the Build: the deload paid off exactly where it was supposed to — incline 155×5 came back at RIR 2, clearing the re-attempt gate on the nose and reproducing the W14 line rep-for-rep, so 160 fires W18 Tue with the guard re-registered tighter because 160 already owns miss #1 (Adj #257); the rear-delt posted the repeat RIR 4/4 the nudge protocol asks for, so 145 fires W18 (Adj #258); and the decline crunch put its first full Tue 3×12 at +10 on the board (Adj #262). The counterweight is the arm side — the pushdown's back half collapsed to its worst line at 27.5 in either slot and the preacher opener gave back its click, both on the most favorable Tuesday the slot gets, so the §10.A 2nd-movement decision that was due at the Tue brief is CARRIED UNMADE to W18: the tendon is not the constraint (12th consecutive clean session), the arm dose is (Adj #259/#260/#263). The DB lateral's soft-opener gate goes to the W18 brief too, unresolved after five full-dose weeks (Adj #261). Two live pace questions still land this week: Wed's 6×1K @ T opens at the 7:50 slow end and a firm over-anchor read reopens the band toward 7:50-7:55 (Adj #241); Fri's 5×1000m @ I is the decisive band test — open at the 7:00 fast end, run the prescribed 90 s JOG recoveries after Sunday's walked ones, full ~17.5 min dose, and a sub-anchor read with the confound removed reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251/#252). Cadence watch re-armed at I, next read Fri (Adj #253). Saturday is the first full-dose Hyp B since the deload and fires both held bumps — DB lateral 35→40 (Adj #248) and seated calf 355→365 (Adj #249), whose AM Achilles gate reads Mon 8-17; its pushdown is also the re-read that governs the W18 2nd-movement call.
